description: Use it to buy a 24h Position Lifecycle bundle and run the guard, receipt and close steps inside it. Each call selects the branch with "op": begin, guard, receipt or close. Do not use it for a single pre-trade guard (use trade_guard op check_safety), for unrelated positions, or with a token after close. Returns the lifecycleId plus one-time plc_ token and expiry for begin, and the guard verdict, signed execution receipt or combined lifecycle summary for the in-window steps. Absorbs the deprecated names position_lifecycle_begin and position_lifecycle_step.

chain.description: Chain-name filter (e.g. "ethereum", "base", "hyperevm"); not a numeric chain id

lifecycle_token.description: One-time plc_ token from the purchase

name: position_lifecycle
